priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect at all times.
Cast Arcane Surge as your primary cooldown to initiate your burn phase.
Cast Touch of the Magi immediately after Arcane Surge, or on cooldown if Surge is not available for at least 30 seconds.
Use Evocation if mana drops below 10% and your major cooldowns (Surge/Touch) are not active.
Cast Arcane Barrage whenever you reach 20 stacks of Arcane Salvo to spend the proc.
Cast Arcane Missiles whenever Clearcasting is active to build Arcane Salvo stacks.
Cast Arcane Orb to generate Arcane Charges if you have 2 or fewer charges.
Use Presence of Mind with Arcane Blast if you have 1 or fewer Arcane Charges to build power quickly.
Cast Arcane Pulse (if talented) as a high-priority filler if you have fewer than 3 Arcane Charges and mana is above 30%.
Cast Arcane Blast as your main filler to generate Arcane Charges.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities (like Berserking) during the Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi window.
Cast Arcane Barrage at the very end of your Touch of the Magi or Arcane Surge window if you have 15 or more Arcane Salvo stacks.
Cast Arcane Barrage if the target is about to die.
